subject: EOQ sprint: consumption sweetener & trial extension for NovusAI
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Carolyn Park <carolyn@novusai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 21:12:00 -0700
Subject: EOQ sprint: consumption sweetener & trial extension for NovusAI

Hi Carolyn —

Quick note as we hit the last week of the quarter: we can extend your pilot window by two weeks and add a one-time consumption credit to cover the extra usage while you run the new intent-routing tests. Proposed: 150k token credit (applied as prepaid consumption) + trial extension through 2027-04-14.

This is a limited EOQ bridge to remove the operations friction so your eng team can complete the final integration tests and we can convert to the paid plan before April billing. If you want it, I can loop in our procurement/legal to issue a short addendum for signatures today — we can ship the credit as soon as the DocuSign is back.

Attachments: SLA_addendum.pdf (one-page addendum), credit_allocation_sheet.xlsx (allocation and activation steps).

If this works, reply "GO" and I’ll route paperwork.

— Markus
Markus Klein | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

From: Carolyn Park <carolyn@novusai.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: NovusAI Procurement <procurement@novusai.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EOQ sprint: consumption sweetener & trial extension for NovusAI

Thanks Markus —

Appreciate the flexibility. Two quick questions from my side before I tag procurement: 1) For accounting, can you confirm whether the 150k token credit will appear as a prepaid credit (one-off) or a conditional rebate? 2) Any change to data residency/security terms in the addendum? Security wants a single line confirming no outbound log sharing beyond our tenancy.

I’m copying our procurement team — they’ll need the addendum and an invoice or order form to process the one-off credit. Can you send the exact wording you need signed?

— Carolyn
Carolyn Park | Head of ML Platforms, NovusAI
carolyn@novusai.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EOQ sprint: consumption sweetener & trial extension for NovusAI

Markus / Ben —

Confirming internal approval to proceed with the proposal as-is: 150k token prepaid credit + two-week extension. Acceptable as a one-time prepaid activation (book as contra-revenue in quarter close). Security check: the addendum must include the line Carolyn requested — "No customer data or request logs will be shared outside the customer's tenancy; Redwood will maintain audit logs available on request." Ben, please patch that into the addendum (SLA_addendum.pdf) and send to Carolyn + procurement.

Also, include the HubSpot deal link and the DocuSign routing so finance has the PO/contract trail. I will approve up to $15k equivalent consumption value for accounting.

- Karthik
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Carolyn Park <carolyn@novusai.com>, NovusAI Procurement <procurement@novusai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EOQ sprint: consumption sweetener & trial extension for NovusAI

Carolyn / procurement team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is an updated SLA_addendum.pdf with the security sentence included, plus the credit_allocation_sheet.xlsx that spells out activation steps and how the prepaid credit will appear on your billing (one-time credit, applied on activation date).

Summary of the offer: 
- 150,000 token prepaid credit (applied immediately upon signed addendum)
- Pilot extended to 2027-04-14 for the NovusAI tenant ID NOV-7782
- No change to normal data residency; addendum confirms no outbound sharing of logs beyond tenant.

Next steps: 
1) Carolyn: confirm acceptance and we’ll create a DocuSign envelope (HubSpot deal linked below).
2) Procurement: sign the addendum and return PO if required — if you can route the DocuSign today we’ll activate credits within 2 business hours of completed signature.

Doc links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/34567/HN-2027-0423 | DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/novus/HS-2027-0423

— Markus
Markus Klein | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
